taxonomy_note: Analyst planning lens; reassess actual root cause.

controls.source_trace: Inspect recursive merge/set/path utilities and the exact resulting object. Trace prototype-affecting properties to a security-sensitive lookup, rendering, configuration or option consumer.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an isolated Node/browser process with fresh objects and an inert marker. Compare own-property and inherited-property values before/after the real merge. Then determine whether the affected consumer reads that value; restore/terminate the fixture rather than modifying a shared process prototype.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An unusual JSON key is not proof of prototype mutation. Mutation without a reachable security consumer establishes a narrower primitive, not automatic code execution.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use supported safe merge/data structures and explicit ownership/schema checks at the relevant boundary. Retest nested paths, normal merge behavior and the actual affected consumer in a clean runtime.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
